{{Quote|They made their first strike while Lord Angral's vessels were still gathered at Ziost. We arrived just in time to halt their advance on the central garrison. Do they think they can hold this world? Do they hope to fortify it as a staging point for a strike against Dromund Kaas?|Darth Malgus, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''central garrison''' was a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The central garrison was first mentioned in the [[2012]] resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
